checks.name: Pending hash survives reload, blocks sends and resolves only its canonical receipt
Mined receipt with stale transaction context survives reload and manually recovers without resending
Transient receipt context recovers on the third read without another wallet entry

actualCapturedReceiptReplay.scope: Replay already captured actual public receipt/transaction/canonical-header with installed viem formatters through current actual wrapping validator; exact sender/calldata and all1:1 backing/mint/Wrap logs checked.

reviewed: Same expected transaction hash with stale or pending block context remains pending; saved hash is retained through reload.
Three bounded reads can recover automatically without another wallet entry; manual retry only reads the saved hash.
Wrong receipt/transaction hash and unchanged sender/chain/to/calldata/backing/mint log guards remain hard failures.
limitations: Transient inconsistent provider context is a tested scenario and a plausible explanation, not a proven historical cause of the user screenshot.
Only three affected browser groups were rerun; baseline wallet flows were previously accepted and were not changed.

Local fixture cold-start failures were isolated by an exclusive optimizer cache, explicit JSX-runtime prebundling and only loopback development WebSocket allowance. No product code changed for those test fixes.
